verdict.rationale: Whether a state business-filing portal publishes its operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts up front is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes, and the Commission and Clerk's Information System sites were not crawled because their robots.txt disallows all agents. Nothing in the pack shows whether such limits are published.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
